modmenu.summaryTranslation.handytables: Open your crafting table and other workstations straight from your inventory.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.handytabl: Middle-click a crafting table, stonecutter, loom, cartography table, smithing table, grindstone or anvil in your inventory to use it without placing it. In creative, hold Ctrl while middle-clicking.
config.handytables.title: Handy Tables
config.handytables.group.sounds.descript: Sounds Handy Tables plays for you only.
config.handytables.open_sound.descriptio: Play the block's placing sound when a station opens from your item. Only you hear it.
config.handytables.save.tooltip: Save the changes. They apply at once.
config.handytables.reset.tooltip: Set every option to its default. Nothing is saved until you press Save Changes.
config.handytables.undo.tooltip: Go back to the saved settings.
